## Global Instructions

### Commit message conventions

When generating Git commit messages, use Conventional Commits.

Format:

<type>(<scope>): <description>

Allowed types:

- feat
- fix
- refactor
- test
- docs
- chore
- build
- ci
- perf
- style

Rules:

- Write all commit messages in English.
- Infer scope from changed files.
- Keep subject under 72 characters.
- Use the concise imperative mood.
- Do not use vague messages like "update files" or "misc changes".

### Domain language

When a domain model exists, use the canonical terms from the relevant `CONTEXT.md` in all communication and project work. If `CONTEXT-MAP.md` exists, use it to select the applicable glossary. Explicitly resolve any terminology conflicts before proceeding.
